text:
zara.peopleops: Urgent help pls  my partner had an emergency wisdom tooth extraction while we were on parental leave in Cancun. Clinic billed us and we don't have the physical ID card. Can benefits confirm coverage and advise on claim submission?
mike.benefits: Sorry to hear that. Can you share member name, DOB, last4 of member ID, date of service, clinic name/address, and a photo of the receipt?
zara.peopleops: Member: Mateo Reyes / DOB 1991-07-18 / member last4 7718. Date: 2029-03-21. Clinic: Clinica Dental Riviera / Av. Kukulkan 44, Cancun. Receipt: https://files.redwood.example/RECEIPT_0321.jpg (they charged MXN 3,400).
cigna-bot: [auto] Case CG-77812 created. Please provide itemized invoice, provider tax ID, brief clinical note, and CDT codes if available. International claims processing may require scanned translations.
mike.benefits: We'll open the claim and request direct billing confirmation. If clinic can't bill Cigna directly, we'll prepare a reimbursement packet. Keep all itemized docs and any English translation.
carrie.hr: If member needs a short-term company advance to cover the out-of-pocket, file an expense flagged "medical-advance" and attach receipt. Finance will review.
mike.benefits: Note: dental emergency extractions abroad sometimes map to CDT D7140. Ask clinic to add an itemized line showing extraction code and anesthetic. That speeds adjudication. Also ask them to include local tax ID so carrier can validate provider.
cigna-bot: [auto] Coverage check: provisional coverage confirmed for emergency dental extraction under travel coverage rider. Claim number pending after docs received.
zara.peopleops: Clinic emailed an itemized bill and PA note stating "uncontrolled pain, removal #32, local anesthesia". Forwarded to you. They also asked if assignment of benefits is possible.
mike.benefits: For out-of-network overseas providers assignment is sometimes allowed; we'll request provider credentialing info. If they accept assignment we'll include AOB template. Otherwise member pays and we file for reimbursement.
cigna-bot: [auto] Update CG-77812: preliminary claim number CLM-2029-03-9002 assigned. Please upload itemized invoice and proof of payment within 14 days. Expected adjudication window: 15-45 days.
carrie.hr: Please upload copies to HRA under "international medical/dental" so we have a company record. If member requests advance, tag me and finance.
zara.peopleops: Uploaded docs to portal and submitted expense request for potential advance. Appreciate the quick help.
mike.benefits: Closing loop: we've attached clinical note and invoice to clot. If Cigna requires translation we'll help with a certified attestation. Reopen thread if reimbursement or EOB differs from estimate.
